items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1959-08-20
items.q: I got used to Tiger Rag right there with Jack Kerr in New Orleans. We the first one started singing Tiger Rag. Jack Kerr band.

ctx.x: And did he play any other instrument?
No. A lot of people don't know I played with Celestan but I did, I played with Celestan, Goodwild. But Jack Kerr was my main man you know.
What did you play, second trumpet with Celestan?

items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1960-04-04
items.q: I was practicing a little bit with Jack Kerr... Jack Kerr and then the boys made me quit Jack and we made up a band

ctx.x: Well, I was going to ask you about the other fellas. When you got here in the city, did any of them practice long hours or anything?
No. I was practicing a little bit with Jack Kerr, but not very much. Not much.
